structured_output.what_is_happening: JEANTRUMP ("Jean Phil Trump") is a derivative of Jean Phil / Jean Philanthrope, a viral French shadowboxing character that started on about Sept 17, 2026 (Know Your Meme). That meme already has a lead Solana coin, $JEANPHIL, at about $7.5M market cap. This coin mashes Jean Phil's blonde bowl-cut look together with Trump. Trump's real hair change in early September drew wide coverage, and the coin's description reads "They did a tremendous job on my new haircut." At least 4 "Jean Phil Trump" clones launched within about 7 minutes of each other. This one is the clear winner of that clone race: $40k market cap against about $3.4k for the others. It is up about 10x in 13 minutes and sits near its all-time high, with the bonding curve at 103 of the 115 virtual SOL it needs to migrate. I found no specific trigger post, such as Trump himself or a large account posting a Jean Phil edit.
